title: Domain Impersonation Detection Rules
description: A versioned collection of rules for identifying domains that may impersonate legitimate services.

$schema.description: A URI reference to the JSON Schema used to validate this rules file.

version.description: The version of the rules file format.

rules.description: Detection rules used to identify potentially impersonating domain names.

rule.description: A rule describing a suspicious domain pattern and the legitimate domain it may impersonate.

id.description: A unique, lowercase, hyphen-separated identifier for the detection rule.

pattern.description: A regular expression used to match potentially impersonating domain names.

legitimateDomain.description: The legitimate domain name that the suspicious domain may be impersonating.

date.description: The date the rule was added or last updated, in YYYY-MM-DD format.

category.description: The category of the legitimate service, such as development, finance, or shopping.

note.description: Optional additional context about the impersonation technique or threat addressed by the rule.
